org: TASO (Transforming Access and Student Outcomes in Higher Education)
accessNotes: All guide pages are static Quarto HTML and were fully readable, including the R/ggplot2 theme code shown under 'Show the code', which provides exact colours, sizes and fonts. Example PNGs downloaded from the guide.
summary: A UK higher-education research charity's report/social chart style built in R/ggplot2: warm 'putty' (#EDEBE3) background, serif Neuton active headline above a Barlow statistical subtitle, sparse light gridlines, a dark slate x-axis baseline with long ticks, and italic bottom-left source/notes. Charts favour direct labelling, a single peacock-blue (#3b66bc) series with greyed/tinted context and arrow annotations for social versions.

colors.categoricalNotes: Count-specific palettes from the R code: 1 colour = #3b66bc; 2 = #3b66bc,#07dbb3; 3 = +#f9466c; 4 = +#485866; 5 = +#e4e2d9. A principles-page example uses an alternative 3-colour line palette #3b66bc, #00a8da, #07dbb3. For line charts aim for no more than four or five colours. Gradients can be generated with RColorBrewer or the learnui data-colour-picker.
colors.notes: Brand colours listed: #07dbb3 (teal), #3b66bc (peacock blue), #e4e2d9, #edebe3 (putty), #f9466c (pink-red), #485866 (slate). Diverging list is the 'taso_likert' 5-point palette. Zero/reference line drawn in #404040. Text black but data labels may be white on coloured bars. In the social example, non-highlighted bars are a pale tint of the blue (alpha-reduced #3b66bc over putty) rather than grey.

title.weight: normal (Neuton serif; bold in report version)

axisTitle.placement: x-axis title centred below axis; y-axis title usually omitted (y = "")

typography.notes: Title font is Neuton (serif); all other text Barlow at base 12pt (ggplot sizes in pt). Title must be the largest text, then subtitle; all other text smaller. Text should almost always be horizontal. Direct line-end labels in Barlow bold 3.5 (ggplot mm units).

structure.gridlines: Major gridlines only, solid #CECABC at 0.3 linewidth (both directions by theme_minimal in the default example; examples prune to fewer lines); minor gridlines removed.
structure.axisLine: x-axis line drawn in #485866 at 0.5 linewidth; y-axis line removed. A separate zero line (geom_hline/vline) in #404040 solid.
structure.ticks: x-axis ticks only, #485866, long (0.3 cm); labels offset 7pt below.
structure.zeroLine: Yes — solid #404040 line at 0 (y=0 for vertical bars, x=0 for horizontal bars).
structure.yAxisTitle: omitted by default (y = ""); formal report version may show rotated y title
structure.frame: none — whole plot sits on a putty rectangle with 0.25in margin; no panel border
structure.background: #EDEBE3 putty for both plot and panel
structure.notes: plot.title.position and plot.caption.position = 'plot' so title and caption align to the left edge of the whole graphic, not the panel.

legend.directLabels: Strongly preferred: legend.position='none'; series names placed at line ends in bold, coloured to match.
legend.title: not shown
legend.notes: Guide argues integrating the legend into the chart avoids eye-travel.

marks.bars: Flat solid fills, no outline, no rounding; horizontal bars recommended to keep text horizontal; ggplot default ~0.9 width. Value labels in white bold inside bar end.
marks.lines: Default ggplot line width with point markers at each observation; direct labels at end.
marks.notes: No gradients or 3D effects. Error bars shown in formal reports for 95% CIs.

labels.dataLabels: Label points directly where possible (allows dropping axes); bold white labels inside bars.
labels.dates: Plain years (2019, 2020...) with no 'Year' axis title.
labels.notes: Use bold/italic in annotations and data labels only with purpose.

furniture.title: Active title stating the key takeaway (max two lines) in Neuton; subtitle is formal statistical title, e.g. 'Figure 18: Average anxiety level over time by disability type'. In formal reports the figure number + title may sit above the chart in bold blue serif with a neutral descriptive title.
furniture.source: Caption bottom-left, italic, smallest text: 'Source: ...' then blank line then 'Notes: ...'.
furniture.logo: TASO logo bottom-right for web/social versions; omitted in PDF reports that already carry branding.
furniture.other: Key words in the title can be coloured in the highlight series colour (ggtext markdown) to act as a legend.

annotations: Concise annotations near relevant data, distinguished by font size/weight; social example uses a curved thin dark-grey arrow and bold dark-grey Barlow callout text.
layout: Default 180mm × 120mm for A4 PDF reports (180mm max width; height flexible). Social sizes: Instagram story 1080×1920, carousel 1080×566 / 1080×1350 / 1080×1080, X 1600×900 (min 600×335), LinkedIn 1200×627. Export PNG/JPEG. 0.25in plot margin.
accessibility: Foreground/background contrast must pass WCAG AA. Alt text formula (Amy Cesal): 'Chart type of type of data where reason for including chart'. Refers to Government Analysis Function and RSS guides.

chartTypes.notes: Use FT Visual Vocabulary to choose; RAISE principles (Reduce clutter, Annotate, Integrate text, Show the data, Engage).

distinctiveRules.rule: Whole chart background is putty #EDEBE3 (plot and panel), not white.
Title set in serif Neuton; everything else in sans Barlow; title is always the largest text, subtitle second.
distinctiveRules.quote: The fonts for the charts are Neuton for the header and Barlow for all other text.

distinctiveRules.rule: Title is an active takeaway sentence; subtitle beneath is the formal statistical title (optionally prefixed 'Figure N:').
distinctiveRules.quote: opt for an active title that succinctly captures the key takeaway, complemented by a formal statistical subtitle

distinctiveRules.rule: Gridlines solid #CECABC at thin weight; no minor gridlines.
Only the x (category/value) axis line drawn, slate #485866 0.5 weight, with long (0.3cm) slate ticks; no y-axis line.
distinctiveRules.quote: axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "#485866", linewidth = 0.5) ... axis.ticks.length = unit(0.3, "cm")

distinctiveRules.rule: A solid dark #404040 zero line is drawn at the bar baseline.
Source/notes caption bottom-left, italic, smallest text, 'Source:' prefix then 'Notes:' on a separate line.
distinctiveRules.quote: The caption should be in the bottom left of the chart. It should be in italics, and smaller than the rest of the text

distinctiveRules.rule: Title and caption are aligned to the left edge of the whole graphic (plot), not the panel.
No legend box; series labelled directly at line ends in bold coloured text.
distinctiveRules.quote: incorporate legends directly into the chart

distinctiveRules.rule: Single-series charts use peacock blue #3b66bc; multi-series follow fixed order blue, teal #07dbb3, pink #f9466c, slate #485866, light #e4e2d9.
Highlight one category in full blue and show others as a pale tint; colour the matching words in the title in the highlight colour.
distinctiveRules.quote: By using ggtext::element_markdown, we can use markdown stylings to colour specific words in the chart to highlight a point

distinctiveRules.rule: Text should almost always be horizontal — prefer horizontal bars over rotated labels; drop redundant axis titles like 'Year'.
distinctiveRules.quote: Text should almost always be horizontal.

distinctiveRules.rule: Logo bottom-right on web/social versions only.
distinctiveRules.quote: If you are including the logo, it should be in the bottom right corner
180mm (width) x 120mm (height) is the default standard chart size for A4 PDF reports.

referenceImages.describes: Template vertical bar chart on putty #EDEBE3 background. Two-line left-aligned black serif (Neuton) title at top, sans (Barlow) regular subtitle directly below. Four flat peacock-blue bars with small gaps. Thin light-beige gridlines both horizontal and vertical (vertical through bar centres). Dark slate solid zero line at 0 plus a separate x-axis line slightly below with long downward tick marks at each category. Grey Barlow tick labels; small centred x-axis title 'Axis Title'; no y title, no legend. Bottom-left italic 'Source: This is the source in italics' and, after a blank line, italic 'Notes: ...'.

Formal report version: bold blue serif 'Figure 2: When we control for KS4 ...' headline above (outside) a putty panel. Inside, black Barlow statistical subtitle top-left, horizontal medium-blue bars with dark error bars (95% CI), black vertical zero axis line at left, light vertical gridlines at £5,000 steps, slate x-axis baseline with ticks, currency tick labels £0–£15,000, centred x title 'Average earnings premium', rotated y title 'Highest qualification'. Italic Source line and multi-line italic Note block bottom-left.

Social version on putty: large black Neuton active title with key phrase 'top third HE provider graduates' coloured blue; Barlow two-line subtitle. Horizontal bars: top bar solid peacock blue, all others pale blue-grey tint. Grey category labels right-aligned to the left of a black zero line; light vertical gridlines; slate x baseline with ticks; no axis titles. Bold dark-grey annotation text with curved thin arrow pointing to the highlighted bar. Italic source bottom-left; teal/blue 'TASO' wordmark logo bottom-right.
